sloka: उत्पेततुस्ततस्तूर्णं जघ्नतुश्च परस्परम्।भुजैश्चिक्षिपतुर्वीरावन्योन्यमपराजितौ।जग्मतुस्तौ श्रमं वीरौ बाहुयुद्धे परन्तपौ ।। ६.९८.२८ ।।
transliteration: utpetatustatastūrṇaṁ jaghnatuśca parasparam।bhujaiścikṣipaturvīrāvanyonyamaparājitau।jagmatustau śramaṁ vīrau bāhuyuddhe parantapau ।। 6.98.28 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, both of them fully endowed with strength, with their weapons broken, who resembled glowing fires, fought with their fists.
